item.name: protect Lambda retries with Powertools Idempotency
item.summary: A Node.js Lambda wrapper that uses the actual Powertools IdempotencyConfig and DynamoDBPersistenceLayer around a business-keyed handler. Hosted preview is unavailable; the private adapter does not execute this product.

manifest.original_contribution: Original, focused Node.js Lambda integration module for DynamoDB-backed idempotency for business events using the pinned AWS Powertools TypeScript package.

delivery_contract.format: self-contained JSON with exact UTF-8 file contents
delivery_contract.side_effects: depends on the installed Powertools library and may emit logs, telemetry, or call AWS services when invoked

validation_contract.private_worker_loader_preview: unavailable; native Node entrypoint uses local fixture only

manifest.supported_boundary: A Node.js Lambda wrapper that uses the actual Powertools IdempotencyConfig and DynamoDBPersistenceLayer around a business-keyed handler. Native Node.js Lambda runtime only; no hosted preview, deployment, or service-side success assertion.
manifest.native_preview_blocker: The complete Powertools dependency closure and matching Lambda/AWS service runtime are not available in the hosted private Worker Loader.

","mime_type":"text/plain; charset=utf-8","path":"LICENSE","sha256":"c71d239df91726fc519c6eb72d318ec65820627232b2f796219e87dcf35d0ab4","size_bytes":11357},{"content":"# Powertools Idempotency for Lambda (TypeScript/JavaScript)

Wrap a Lambda business handler with the actual Powertools Idempotency utility and DynamoDB persistence layer. Choose a stable business key in the event (such as `body.orderId`); Lambda request IDs change across retries and are unsuitable as idempotency keys.

## Install and use

Install these exact direct versions: Powertools Idempotency 2.36.0 and AWS SDK DynamoDB client 3.1156.0. Run Node.js 20 or newer in Lambda. Create a DynamoDB table with a string partition key named `id`; the Lambda role needs `dynamodb:GetItem`, `PutItem`, `UpdateItem`, and `DeleteItem` on that table.

```js
import { makeDynamoIdempotent } from './src/idempotency.mjs';

async function chargeOrder(event) {
  const { orderId, amount } = event.body;
  return chargeCustomer({ orderId, amount, idempotencyKey: orderId });
}
export const handler = makeDynamoIdempotent(chargeOrder, {
  table_name: process.env.IDEMPOTENCY_TABLE,
  event_key_jmespath: 'body.orderId',
  payload_validation_jmespath: 'body.[customerId,amount,currency]',
  expires_after_seconds: 3600,
});
```

Powertools stores the completed response in DynamoDB and can replay it for a duplicate. It cannot make an external payment provider atomic with DynamoDB. If the provider succeeds and Lambda fails before the idempotency result is persisted, a retry may call the provider again. Pass the same business key to a provider that supports idempotency and reconcile uncertain outcomes.

## Native private preview and boundary

`preview.mjs` runs the real Powertools idempotency wrapper twice against a local in-memory cache fixture and confirms the handler runs once. This exercises the idempotency core, not the delivered DynamoDB persistence layer, durable state, or cross-Lambda coordination. Hosted preview remains unavailable because the gateway does not provide a native Node runtime or DynamoDB.

## Files and source

Original integration code is Apache-2.0. Powertools Idempotency 2.36.0 and its `@aws-lambda-powertools/jmespath` dependency are MIT-0; exact source revision and npm integrity are listed in `source-provenance.json`.

import { CachePersistenceLayer } from '@aws-lambda-powertools/idempotency/cache';

const SLUG = 'lambda-powertools-idempotency-ts';

/** Native Node preview: run real Powertools idempotency core against an isolated in-memory cache fixture. */
export async function preview({ configuration, selected_components } = {}) {
  if (!configuration || configuration.language !== 'javascript'
      || typeof configuration.table_name !== 'string' || typeof configuration.event_key_jmespath !== 'string'
      || !Array.isArray(selected_components) || selected_components.length !== 1
      || selected_components[0] !== 'base') {
    return { ok: false, status: 'invalid', slug: SLUG, operation_count: 0, diagnostic_codes: ['configuration_invalid'] };
  }
  const values = new Map();
  const client = {
    async get(key) { return values.get(key) ?? null; },
    async set(key, value, options = {}) {
      if (options.NX || options.conditionalSet === 'onlyIfDoesNotExist') {
        if (values.has(key)) return null;
      }
      values.set(key, value); return 'OK';
    },
    async del(keys) { for (const key of keys) values.delete(key); return keys.length; },
  };
  try {
    const config = new IdempotencyConfig({ eventKeyJmesPath: configuration.event_key_jmespath, expiresAfterSeconds: 60 });
    const persistenceStore = new CachePersistenceLayer({ client, expiresAfterSeconds: 60 });
    let calls = 0;
    const handler = makeIdempotent(async record => { calls++; return { accepted: true, order_id: record.orderId }; }, { persistenceStore, config });
    const event = { orderId: 'protected-preview' };
    const context = { getRemainingTimeInMillis() { return 30000; } };
    const first = await handler(event, context);
    const second = await handler(event, context);
    if (calls !== 1 || first?.order_id !== second?.order_id) throw new Error('idempotency_fixture_failed');
    return { ok: true, status: 'valid', slug: SLUG, operation_count: calls, verification_count: 1, diagnostic_codes: ['in_memory_fixture_not_dynamodb'], selected_components };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, status: 'unavailable', slug: SLUG, operation_count: 0, diagnostic_codes: ['runtime_unavailable'] };
  }
}

","mime_type":"application/json","path":"source-provenance.json","sha256":"c54c56a7176076232861e56c02c8713e1fe694002ed62be5a5b3f8162ab4805d","size_bytes":1784},{"content":"import { IdempotencyConfig, makeIdempotent } from '@aws-lambda-powertools/idempotency';
import { DynamoDBPersistenceLayer } from '@aws-lambda-powertools/idempotency/dynamodb';

const TABLE = /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{3,255}$/;

export function makeDynamoIdempotent(handler, {
  table_name,
  event_key_jmespath,
  expires_after_seconds = 3600,
  payload_validation_jmespath,
} = {}) {
  if (typeof handler !== 'function') throw new Error('handler_required');
  if (typeof table_name !== 'string' || !TABLE.test(table_name)) throw new Error('invalid_table_name');
  if (typeof event_key_jmespath !== 'string' || !event_key_jmespath.trim()) throw new Error('event_key_jmespath_required');
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(expires_after_seconds) || expires_after_seconds < 1 || expires_after_seconds > 31536000) {
    throw new Error('invalid_expiration');
  }
  const persistenceStore = new DynamoDBPersistenceLayer({ tableName: table_name });
  const config = new IdempotencyConfig({
    eventKeyJmesPath: event_key_jmespath,
    expiresAfterSeconds: expires_after_seconds,
    ...(payload_validation_jmespath ? { payloadValidationJmesPath: payload_validation_jmespath } : {}),
    throwOnNoIdempotencyKey: true,
  });
  return makeIdempotent(handler, { persistenceStore, config });
}
